theme: Buying protection for the disasters you cannot absorb
title: Layering Reinsurance Against a Ruinous Year
strategies: trivial: spread the premium budget as an equal participation share across every catalog layer (the checker's own reference construction)
greedy: buy the cheapest rate-on-line layers first at full participation until the budget runs out, ignoring whether the purchased bands are contiguous from retention

strong: re-simulate the full scenario set (occurrence cap, aggregate reinstatement cap, ruin-on-breach) for every contiguous window of the tower the budget can fund, and keep whichever program actually survives and profits best -- exploiting contiguity of coverage rather than nominal recovery-per-premium
invalid: emits an out-of-range participation share (-1) for every layer (infeasible)
